Greg's decision, relayed verbatim by Engram::Advisor (TermAl mailbox b9d13887 #741, 2026-10-13 16:00:55Z; recorded by Termal::Fable2): "Greg approves the architects' recommendation for w-65fb: adopt A as the durable model and classify it as a full-store migration. Deliver it in two stages: (1) durable model plus explicit structured refusal/candidate retention whenever any affected run has TermAl responsibility; it MUST leave active-reconciliation acceptance/dependency visibly open and make no claim that the full result shipped; (2) enable active reconciliation only after TermAl delivers G1 host-proven responsibility/settlement attestation, G2 candidate-bound hold-aware admission fencing, and G3 outcome-only uncertain-intent recovery that never dispatches a first execution. No elapsed-time/crash/restart/Engram-only query proves settlement. Please record the decision on w-65fb, create/track the TermAl G1-G3 prerequisite, and prepare the normal design/implementation packets. No migration cutover is approved by this direction."

TermAl items filed:
- w-358040469407: the G1-G3 host prerequisite, P2 (my choice; Greg set no priority), external engram:w-65fb79ead0c3;
- w-1041c4d8aa5c: the T8 exchange-scheduling rule, P3.
